noise_scale_ns: max(5000, 4 * empty_paired_clock_extra_p95_ns, 2 * MAD(A op2 nonlog host wall), 2 * MAD(A op2 nonlog host CPU))
required_state_delta: all four R1 and both F R2 nonlog wall/CPU (op1-op2) >= 2*S; CPU/wall delta discrepancy <= max(S, 0.5*wall delta)
thread_state: both P R2 abs(nonlog wall/CPU op1-op2) <= S; both target-condition R2 F-P op1 nonlog wall/CPU >= 2*S
request_state: both P R2 nonlog wall/CPU op1-op2 >= 2*S with CPU/wall agreement; both target-condition R2 abs(F-P op1 nonlog wall/CPU) <= S
target_gate: for F and P, abs((R2 fresh service op1-op2) - (R2 pretouched service op1-op2)) <= max(2*S, 0.5*minimum positive service wall state delta across all R1 and F R2)
observer_gate: nonlog CPU/wall evidence is mandatory; dummy log absolute cost and fluctuation reported, never subtracted and not included as absolute nonlog noise
fit: C0/C1/C2 same 16 A op record_total_ns; nonnegative p, p+r request-first, p+h actual-thread-first (request branch same C1)
shared_costs: A component means grouped by executor_mode and request_ordinal; record_gap/set_device/postdiagnosis/dispatch_create_join/worker_other/controller_residual/query/prepare/full_other all included once; R1 cell allocation stays in R1 prepare
prediction: 8 deterministic B requests; only fixed cell/mode/ordinal/thread-first states, all costs from A; published and old bounded predictions null; all parameters and predictions frozen before first B request
admission: B same state gate with frozen A S; C2 worker execute, controller execute and full MAE and max-absolute-error all strictly lower than C0/C1; worker and full MAE and max-error reductions exceed scale=max(S, A/B dummy-log fluctuation p95, max absolute B observed shared-total minus A frozen shared-total). Request-equivalent C2 chooses C1. No automatic product upgrade.
interpretation: exploratory conservative stopping criteria, no statistical confidence or future error bound; target intervention identifies combined write history/cache only; fixed size cannot fit byte slope or bandwidth
fixed_two_copy_structural_note: With the same A op set and fixed two copies per request, 2*C0.p equals 2*C1.p+C1.r under NNLS (also when r clips to zero). If the state is request-first, C2 equals C1 and cannot add request-total discrimination here. B still tests conditional state replication when A gate passes; do not fabricate main-metric gain or alter the A/B gate.
